_comment: kinoheld IDs discovered 2026-07-07 via the cinemas(search:) GraphQL query (API capture in scraper/debug/woki_curl.txt); every ID verified against programByMovie. 'website' is the cinema's own site — showtime links point there instead of kinoheld; non-kinoheld ticket deeplinks (CineStar, kinotickets.express, chain shops) are kept. Cinemas with 'source': 'custom' have their scraper in sources/custom.py.

cinemas.name: Kinopolis Bad Godesberg
cinemas._note: Moltkestr. 7 = Bad Godesberg. Scraped from their own CineOrder ticket shop (sources/kinopolis.py), which cineorder_center_oid unlocks: kinoheld was missing newly announced films and filed a few screenings under the wrong film (checked 2026-07-25). The shop also carries the OV/OmU version per screening and the exact prices (sources/cineorder.py) in the same one request. kinoheld_id 837 ('Kinopolis Bonn' there) is kept as the fallback if that shop call ever fails.

cinemas.name: Bonner Kinemathek
cinemas._note: listed as 'Bonner Kinemathek - Kino in der Brotfabrik' on kinoheld

cinemas.name: Stern Lichtspiele
cinemas._note: = CineStar Bonn (Markt 8), listed as 'CineStar Bonn' on kinoheld; keeps its webticketing3.cinestar.de deeplinks

cinemas.name: Metropolis
cinemas._note: mostly-OV house. Not usably on kinoheld (id 974 there is an event venue) — scraped from their CineWeb site, tickets via kinotickets.express. Unmarked foreign-language films are corrected DE->OmU in main.py (fix_metropolis_ov)

cinemas.name: Filmpalette
cinemas._note: their https is broken (cert), http works. kinoheld drops their OmU/OmeU markers — corrected from their homepage text in main.py (apply_filmpalette_languages)

cinemas.name: Rex am Ring
cinemas._note: also kinoheld id 1088, but kinoheld drops nearly all their OmU/OV markers — their own CineWeb site is the truthful source (and has exact kinotickets.express links)

cinemas.name: Kölner Filmhaus
cinemas._note: filmhauskino.de, the address kinoheld still lists, expired — it served a hosting placeholder on 2026-07-30. Their live site is filmhaus-koeln.de ('Filmhaus Kino Köln', the name cinetixx sells under).

cinemas.name: Cineplex Köln
cinemas._note: cineplex.de answers 403 to every non-browser agent, so their prices can only be read by hand — the curated table in web/src/prices.js is all we have for them.

cinemas.name: Cinedom
cinemas._note: Showtimes come from kinoheld, whose deeplinks already point at Cinedom's own CineOrder shop (…?performance=<id>) — so the exact per-screening prices from that shop (sources/cineorder.py) join straight onto them: 320 of 324 future screenings matched on 2026-07-30, the 4 misses being shows whose sale had just closed. Their shop sells no 'Ermäßigt' category because Cinedom grants that fare only at the counter (Mo–Do before 17:00, on presentation of an ID).
